notes.title: More free content!
notes.content:
As a thanks for your support guys I've added 6 new endings to the game plus more.

There's now six new endings to unlock, they're unlocked after you beat b**tard dracula. You can unlock them on any mode and on any difficulty.

The six endings are randomly given so happy hunting!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098326/c72d115158bc051bd4d18a9b0462aac1806066ab.png

There's now a new option in Death's Castle called 'Memories' you can view your unlocked endings here at any time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098326/0bdf058a3de47268fb7a1d3a96b5aaeb7c9676db.png

The new endings give more detail to what happens after the game, and before the game. I also composed three brand new songs just for these new endings.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I've implemented some player feedback also,

Easy mode now has 5 lives instead of 4,
You can now shoot with mousemiddle (If you want to play with one-hand)
Made some minor changes to some bosses,
Added a new Background for every area,
Changed some cutscenes,

Any problems let me know on the forums,

PSD

notes.title: Another day another update, Improved controls!
notes.content:
The contoller works much better now, you can change your thumbstick deadzone in the controller options. The deadzone is how loose your analog stick is, setting it high will fix very loose sticks, setting it low is for newer controllers. (This also prevents the cursor flying off the screen issues)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098326/b6bd3350b1bcfed0ef6b2af6164099bd0c324fbd.png

There's now a dedicated button for using a power-up, this means you can use slow-down at all times, this was a request from a number of users.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098326/6f5b3aa3fd2d57b41be2464bc1324954819feda9.png

CONTROLLER

Left Trigger - Slow down the bat,
Right Trigger - Speed-up the bat,
A Button - Slow ball,
B Button - Fast ball,
X Button - Use power-up,
Y Button - Switch power-up,

MOUSE

LMB - Slow ball,
RMB - Fast ball,
SPACE BAR - Use power-up,
Mouse Wheel - Switch power-up,

I've also fixed all bugs and memory leaks, so there shouldn't be any issues,

Any problems let me know on the forums, 

Paul
